chain.text: Domaine des Trois Chênes farms 18ha (11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc) on clay/flint, averaging 62,000 bottles; 2024 gave 48,000 after May hail. Organic since 2019; biodynamic conversion began 2023, certification earliest 2026. Exports are 41% (Belgium, Japan); Japan requires sulphites under 60mg/L. Two past failures: a 2022 tank 4 temperature drift (11,000 euros loss; controllers now calibrated, second probe added) and a 2023 label error (900 bottles recalled; two signatures required). Rules: no irrigation on western plots, harvest decided by three mornings of measurements, tanks above 28°C cooled within four hours. Pending: lighter bottles (importer unconfirmed, no costing) and eastern parcel replanting after 2027.
